items.title: Jane Monheit interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 20, 2010
items.q: I’ll go to the gym with like Lady Gaga screaming in my headphones

ctx.x: I have so much fun with today’s pop music. Because it’s a release. Like I’ll go to the gym with like Lady Gaga screaming in my headphones, and it makes the treadmill fun. There is something to be said for every single genre of music. And people who say, “Oh well I just hate this kind of music and won’t listen to it.” Well then try again, because there’s something great about everything.
You and Rick have a very romantic story. You’ve talked about meeting him and he was pursuing you, and I guess it was a mutual pursuance.
